description: Estonia Annual Accounts - e-Business Register Financials. Get the filed annual accounts (majandusaasta aruanne) of Estonian companies by registry code (registrikood, 8 digits) from the e-Business Register: revenue, operating profit, net profit, total assets, equity and liabilities, checked against the balance sheet. One row per company and fiscal year (up to 3 years). Use it for Estonian KYB, credit checks and supplier vetting when you need the numbers. If the run is not finished in time, the tool returns {status, runId, note} - call regdata_run_result with that runId instead of re-running (re-running bills twice). No API key. Advanced fields beyond this schema are also accepted (regdata_describe lists them).

companyIds.description: Estonian company registry codes (registrikood), 8 digits, up to 1,000 per run. Example: 10000018.
companyIds.title: Registry codes

maxItems.description: Optional cap on billed dataset items returned.

years.description: How many of the most recent fiscal years to return for each company (1 to 3). Each year is one row and one charge.
years.title: Fiscal years per company

name: regdata_estonia_annual_accounts
